  Generalization: In SEM, model shared theoretical variance using explicit residual covariances in lavaan. Visually present SEM diagrams using horizontal aspect ratios to ensure spatial legibility.

⚖️ Applicable Methodology Rules & Boundary Conditions:
- [PRN-20260923-3A66FF] Principle: Model ERQ as a single latent mediator with its two subscales ERQ_R and ERQ_S as indicators in SEM (ERQ =~ ERQ_R + ERQ_S).
- [PRN-20260923-3A3A2B] Principle: In SEM, a latent variable can be specified with a single observed indicator by fixing factor loading to 1.0 and error variance to Var(y)*(1 - alpha).
